title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats
summary: Anthropic's Claude AI discovered a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats through autonomous genomic analysis, marking a significant milestone where an LLM made a genuine scientific discovery in molecular biology. This finding demonstrates AI's potential to contribute to actual scientific research beyond text generation.
problem_solved: Demonstrates that AI can autonomously identify novel biological mechanisms, potentially accelerating scientific discovery in genetics and molecular biology research.
why_valuable: This breakthrough proves LLMs can make real scientific contributions by analyzing biological data, opening new possibilities for AI-assisted drug discovery and genetic research.
